groups.title: Shared front end and direct completeness

nodes.title: Lexer soundness
nodes.goal: Successful lexing implies Lexes.
nodes.approach: Existing proof.

nodes.title: Lexer completeness
nodes.goal: Lexes implies successful lexing of the specified tokens.
nodes.approach: Existing proof.

nodes.title: Parser soundness
nodes.goal: Successful parsing implies Derives.
nodes.approach: Existing proof.

nodes.title: Parser completeness
nodes.goal: Derives implies successful parsing.
nodes.approach: Existing proof.

nodes.title: Loader soundness
nodes.goal: Successful load implies Loader.Bundled.
nodes.approach: Existing proof; no completeness claim.

nodes.title: Bound finite-snapshot traversal
nodes.goal: A worklist potential decreases even for repeated pops, and the input-derived snapshot_fuel suffices for every closed readable witness reachable from the entry.
nodes.approach: Count unseen registered paths weighted by maximum import/prelude degree, plus outstanding pops. Unused invalid files are not rejected.

nodes.title: Direct typed-loader soundness
nodes.goal: The direct typed-AST loader returns only Bundled outputs with unique module paths and complete import/prelude closure.
nodes.approach: Prove a worklist invariant and parser soundness; use canonical public paths. No dump/read conversion or dump-name restriction is present.

nodes.title: Direct loader acceptance completeness
nodes.goal: Any Bundled witness for the finite source guarantees successful direct loading at the computed fuel bound.
nodes.approach: Combine witness closure and parser completeness with the decreasing potential. Output is existential: the witness may contain irrelevant extra modules. CLI integration and transport to the actually loaded bundle are separate obligations.

nodes.title: Direct elaborator resource policy
nodes.goal: Replace or justify declaration/type/elaboration budgets for all public-buildable finite-source inputs.
nodes.approach: Audit recursion in the direct public elaborator and derive bounds or terminating algorithms. A finite file list alone does not establish elaborator completeness.

nodes.title: Reverse world construction
nodes.goal: Construct an executable world/metadata reading from a public declarative world, up to the fresh names allowed by build completeness.
nodes.approach: Invert public WorldOf using the direct metadata interpretation; split scope, shadowing and requirement cases.

nodes.title: Reverse contexts and signatures
nodes.goal: Public declarative contexts, signatures and type readings are accepted by the direct executable elaborator.
nodes.approach: Prove the backward directions of the direct public context/checking operations; no whole-program model back-translation.

nodes.title: Reverse expression elaboration
nodes.goal: Public expression derivations admit successful direct executable elaboration, with the chosen fresh symbols.
nodes.approach: Separate source expression constructors and expected-type checking once the direct context invariant is fixed.

nodes.title: Reverse bindings and selection
nodes.goal: Public binding/provider/family derivations yield successful direct executable checks with coherent captures and fresh outputs.
nodes.approach: Split unified binding forms, selection and recursive demand against the public rules.

nodes.title: Source-world reading
nodes.goal: Successful internal elaboration constructs a correct source world and requirement reading.
nodes.approach: Existing proof; field-number injection remains explicit.

nodes.title: Conditional body dispatcher
nodes.goal: Pending follows from the existing construct lemmas assuming Hnonmethod_remainingbind and the section world hypotheses.
nodes.approach: Existing conditional internal proof. Reuse its construct lemmas in E03; E11 closes the direct public port's remaining callbacks.

nodes.title: Conditional fresh-link receipts
nodes.goal: Fresh execution supplies context, capture, body and allocation receipts under OneStep, invariants and final-state premises.
nodes.approach: Existing conditional proof; excludes the output certificate.

nodes.title: Link-creator provenance
nodes.goal: Actual whole-program execution preserves authenticated cached-link creators.
nodes.approach: Existing provenance proof, not semantic validity.

nodes.title: Final functor rows
nodes.goal: Actual final and historical functor rows agree with the program tables.
nodes.approach: Existing proof.

nodes.title: Private snapshot readings
nodes.goal: Scoped types retain their semantic lookup under the stated snapshot assumptions.
nodes.approach: Existing helper proof; not actual link_body integration.

nodes.title: Private scope allocation
nodes.goal: A finite private generation scope is connected to actual fresh symbol allocations.
nodes.approach: Existing allocation helpers.

nodes.title: Private merge action
nodes.goal: Private snapshots preserve the source merge action under their explicit scope assumptions.
nodes.approach: Existing merge helpers.

nodes.title: Private capture preservation
nodes.goal: Captured private meanings survive caller rebinding under the explicit transfer assumptions.
nodes.approach: Existing helper theorem.

nodes.title: Runtime result export meanings
nodes.goal: Result transfers install the exported type meaning at the caller generation.
nodes.approach: Existing runtime repair and lookup/grounding proof.

nodes.title: Conditional function assembly
nodes.goal: Completed function traces yield FnElab under Pending, Later and final body agreement.
nodes.approach: Existing conditional proof.

nodes.title: Type/value representation definitions
nodes.goal: Explicit type_represents and value_represents relations exist.
nodes.approach: Definitions only; this done node claims no totality, simulation or whole-program correspondence.

nodes.title: Check primitive signatures
nodes.goal: A source primitive-signature checker agrees with public AtKey/MethodPrimitive conditions for the relevant entries.
nodes.approach: Prove the checker clauses against the shared source world.

nodes.title: Check machine and tag layouts
nodes.goal: A layout checker agrees with public Layouts, including machine declarations and Bool/tag payload layouts.
nodes.approach: Handle the finite designated layout cases using E01 lookups.

nodes.title: Check Ref/Array cast metadata
nodes.goal: The cast metadata checker agrees with public Representations.
nodes.approach: Combine CastEntry cases and exact generated metadata shape.

nodes.title: Check entry ABI
nodes.goal: Executable entry checks agree with EntryPoint, including recursively zero-lane EntryResult cases.
nodes.approach: Use signature lookup and structural result-layout checking.

nodes.title: Check initial platform provisions
nodes.goal: The initial environment/family checker agrees with public Entry and Family judgments.
nodes.approach: Generated platform-family bindings and provision keys may need further decomposition.

nodes.title: Assemble link-check soundness
nodes.goal: Successful public platform checking implies Linked in the elaboration world.
nodes.approach: Assemble EntryPoint, Layouts, Representations and initial entries.

nodes.title: Assemble link-check completeness
nodes.goal: Linked implies acceptance by the public platform checker under the chosen representation.
nodes.approach: Compose the backward directions of the component checker equivalences.

nodes.title: Choose public host adapter
nodes.goal: Define the concrete public host/state adapter used by the fixed default interface.
nodes.approach: Settle value/address conversion and failure behavior without assuming host laws.

nodes.title: Numeric/structural primitive laws
nodes.goal: The public default host satisfies typed laws for non-memory numeric, record and tag operations.
nodes.approach: Transport existing primitive cases through the chosen value relation; split operation groups if transport is not uniform.

nodes.title: Memory and I/O primitive laws
nodes.goal: Default linear-memory, arguments/file and I/O primitives preserve their public signatures and state behavior.
nodes.approach: Reuse internal primitive laws through the host adapter.

nodes.title: Relate concrete heap states
nodes.goal: Specify/prove the public heap predicate corresponding to the concrete heap, including address and held-type readings.
nodes.approach: Separate heap-store representation from primitive stepping; decompose after adapter selection.

nodes.title: Public heap empty/weakening laws
nodes.goal: The public default heap predicate has the required empty-heap and weakening properties.
nodes.approach: Transport existing concrete heap_empty and heap_mono.

nodes.title: Public GC/cast heap laws
nodes.goal: Allocation, dereference, updates and checked casts satisfy public gc_pre/gc_post and heap preservation.
nodes.approach: Establish held-type predicate conversion; split allocation/read/write/cast if it is not a uniform transport.

nodes.title: Assemble default-interface laws
nodes.goal: The chosen default interface satisfies every public interface_laws conjunct for every program view.
nodes.approach: Assemble primitive, unsupported, non-GC and GC laws.

nodes.title: Internal typed-runtime safety
nodes.goal: typed_runtime_program implies that internal run_main never returns XErr.
nodes.approach: Existing proof; no assertion that all accepted programs have certificates.

nodes.title: Fix public runtime invariant
nodes.goal: Define public typing/provision/store invariants strong enough for safety of all admissible semantic programs.
nodes.approach: Assemble the checked data/heap/local invariant and generation protocol with source formation, generated-code provenance and inductive callable/environment realization. Use source derivations directly and fuel induction; do not build a second full expression typing calculus.

nodes.title: Public type-substitution lemmas
nodes.goal: Public typing/grounding admits the substitution and grounding facts required by runtime calls and result exports.
nodes.approach: Structural proofs over the settled typing and environment judgments. Checked for calls of defined functions: PublicBodySlice.callee_realizes (selection succeeds, the type tables agree, and the callee's context is realized from the caller's), from tyof_rel, ctxof_formed, call_agree, call_absorbs and ctx_provision_scoped. Functor provisions are only shown to exist (T15).

nodes.title: Public lookup/provision lemmas
nodes.goal: Typed environments provide correctly typed values, functions, methods and functors at the keys used by execution.
nodes.approach: Prove Satisfies_select_ready: exact public rkey agreement and typed selected provisions under instantiated semantic grounding. Invert inductive environment realization; keep source canonicalization/merge prerequisites explicit. Checked for calls of defined functions: PublicBodySlice.callee_realizes (selection succeeds, the type tables agree, and the callee's context is realized from the caller's), from tyof_rel, ctxof_formed, call_agree, call_absorbs and ctx_provision_scoped. Functor provisions are only shown to exist (T15).

nodes.title: Type basic source elaborations
nodes.goal: Public literal, record, tag and basic expression elaboration preserves the new runtime typing invariant.
nodes.approach: Induct over the corresponding public elaboration rules.

nodes.title: Type source call elaborations
nodes.goal: Ordinary, method and family-call elaborations yield correctly typed runtime calls.
nodes.approach: Split call forms, satisfaction maps and generated methods once T02 is fixed. Checked conditionally: PublicBodySlice.call_core proves direct calls from callee_realizes (T03/T04) and demand_case; calls use CallTheta (call_theta_merged).

nodes.title: Type source bindings/captures
nodes.goal: Public BindItems and provider derivations preserve runtime provision/capture typing.
nodes.approach: Prove FnProvider_capture_ready, followed by method/lambda and functor variants: planned captures realize the certified code context and grounded signatures agree.

nodes.title: Type source control constructs
nodes.goal: Match, loop, return and branch elaboration preserve runtime typing and control permissions.
nodes.approach: Induct over source control rules using the settled frame invariant.

nodes.title: Type generated providers
nodes.goal: Lambda, forwarder, wrapper and linked-provider derivations generate typed callable code with correct interfaces.
nodes.approach: Separate generated-body forms and discharge their closure environments.

nodes.title: Derive program/entry invariants
nodes.goal: Every public ElaboratesIn plus Linked witness establishes runtime code validity and a typed initial entry environment.
nodes.approach: Assemble the public semantic derivation; cover all admissible programs, not just executable build outputs.

nodes.title: Generic compatible primitive step
nodes.goal: Any compatible interface preserves the public typed result/store invariant for a primitive step.
nodes.approach: Use Compatible.interface_laws; do not assume the interface is the default host.

nodes.title: Runtime context extension lemmas
nodes.goal: Grounding and provision typing survive the environment extensions and substitutions used by runtime evaluation.
nodes.approach: Prove weakening and result-generation extension facts under explicit freshness.

nodes.title: Preserve basic runtime forms
nodes.goal: Variables, values, records, tags and primitive expressions preserve the public runtime invariant.
nodes.approach: Prove evaluator case lemmas conditional on the smaller-fuel induction hypothesis. Checked conditionally in PublicBodySlice.safe_all: the slice induction proves these cases from the Pre invariant (positional local typing, merge absorption), with calls, vals, methods, operators, literals, binds, tag construction (tag_check) and arm selection (arms_select) as explicit Section hypotheses.

nodes.title: Preserve call execution
nodes.goal: Function/method calls preserve runtime typing and caller state/environment obligations.
nodes.approach: Adapt the call cases after argument/callable invariants are fixed; split direct and provision calls if needed.

nodes.title: Preserve functor bindings
nodes.goal: Executing unified functor/provider bindings produces correctly typed provision environments.
nodes.approach: Split closure creation, input application and output-generation exports.

nodes.title: Preserve captures and exports
nodes.goal: Captured lexical meanings and caller output generations satisfy runtime invariants after binding/application.
nodes.approach: Prove LinkBody_outputs_ready: source body/result/freshness premises make provision selection and result_environment succeed, extend caller realization and preserve all old supported generations.

nodes.title: Preserve typed GC stores
nodes.goal: Public heap operations preserve store typing, checked handles and non-GC state invariants for any compatible interface.
nodes.approach: Use generic heap laws with the public held-type interpretation, not concrete-host behavior.

nodes.title: Preserve control-flow signals
nodes.goal: Match/loop/return/break cases preserve typing and rule out misplaced control signals at the entry boundary.
nodes.approach: Case analysis using the frame/control permission invariant. Checked conditionally in PublicBodySlice.safe_all: the slice induction proves these cases from the Pre invariant (positional local typing, merge absorption), with calls, vals, methods, operators, literals, binds, tag construction (tag_check) and arm selection (arms_select) as explicit Section hypotheses.

nodes.title: Close runtime preservation induction
nodes.goal: Assemble all public expression/binding/application preservation cases by fuel induction.
nodes.approach: Port the internal induction pattern, exposing any missing evaluator cases as new tasks.

nodes.title: Exclude entry Wrong signals
nodes.goal: For an admissible public program and compatible interface, reference run_main cannot yield Stuck or escaping Breaking at any fuel.
nodes.approach: Apply preservation to the typed entry environment; invert the allowed top-level signals.

nodes.title: Exact internal closure agreement
nodes.goal: Compiled closures equal internal run_main when the table equations hold.
nodes.approach: Existing theorem with explicit table premise.

nodes.title: Conditional optimized agreement
nodes.goal: The production pruning/fast/closure path agrees with internal reference execution, allowing its stated fuel/stuck exceptions.
nodes.approach: Existing bound contract, not agreement with public Runs.

nodes.title: Choose interface-parametric engine
nodes.goal: Parameterize the selected common-target engine by the actual supplied public interface and state.
nodes.approach: Implement the interface strategy chosen at A07 while retaining the measured fast closure path; split remaining primitive dispatch/state operations.

nodes.title: Simulate basic expression steps
nodes.goal: Public basic-expression execution and its compiled closures correspond under explicit fuel/environment hypotheses.
nodes.approach: Prove structural compiler case lemmas, using the common public syntax rather than translating between complete semantic languages.

nodes.title: Simulate calls and captures
nodes.goal: Compiled function/method calls preserve public callable and lexical-capture semantics.
nodes.approach: Use the selected callable/environment invariant for call entry and return.

nodes.title: Simulate functor binding steps
nodes.goal: Compiled unified binding, functor application and output scopes correspond to public execution.
nodes.approach: Split closure creation, binding, application and export cases of the chosen compiler.

nodes.title: Simulate interface/state operations
nodes.goal: Selected primitive/heap operations produce the same observed result and external state as the supplied public interface.
nodes.approach: Apply the supplied-interface adapter theorem; retain heap/address conversion obligations only if the selected runtime needs them.

nodes.title: Relate observations and results
nodes.goal: Translated normal/exit/trap/unsupported/wrong signals and states agree with the public observe function.
nodes.approach: Exhaust the finite signal constructors; keep OutOfFuel as absence of an observation.

nodes.title: Forward finite-fuel adequacy
nodes.goal: Every selected-engine result on an admissible public program has a public Runs derivation.
nodes.approach: Combine common-target compiler correspondence with verified retained transformations and explicit budget translation.

nodes.title: Reverse finite-fuel adequacy
nodes.goal: Every public Runs derivation for an admissible program is reported by the selected engine at some finite budget.
nodes.approach: Prove fuel adequacy for the common-target compiler and retained transformations. No reverse encoding into the old program language is required.

nodes.title: Discharge compiled-table preparation
nodes.goal: The actual executable preparation supplies the table equations used by agreement, with the OCaml trust boundary stated precisely.
nodes.approach: Discharge actual preparation equations for compilation from public programs, resolving the OCaml/extraction boundary explicitly; do not assume Prepared as the final guarantee.

nodes.title: Implement public run wrapper
nodes.goal: Define run on public programs, supplied interfaces, states and observation budgets using the selected executable path.
nodes.approach: Compile the public program directly and connect the selected engine/preparer to observe; no old-model program encoder.

nodes.title: Fix public build configuration
nodes.goal: Fix the intended prelude and canonical finite-source/path configuration for the public build implementation.
nodes.approach: Apply the finite-source contract; preserve intended filesystem behavior and explicit error handling.

nodes.title: Wire direct public elaboration
nodes.goal: Implement loading, direct public-program emission and public platform checking as one executable build path.
nodes.approach: Wire the code before waiting for all soundness proofs, allowing background integration/performance tests.

nodes.title: Define executable public build
nodes.goal: Supply the real build field of Public.CORRECT, returning None on checked failure and public programs on success.
nodes.approach: Define the real build function over the selected finite source snapshot, with no arbitrary-budget completeness loophole.

nodes.title: Prove default compatibility
nodes.goal: Public successful platform linkage implies compatibility with the chosen fixed default interface.
nodes.approach: Combine Ready, full operation support and public interface laws.

nodes.title: Assemble public build soundness
nodes.goal: Build success implies public Builds and default compatibility.
nodes.approach: Unfold the wrapper and combine loader soundness, public refinement and platform/host facts.

nodes.title: Assemble public build completeness
nodes.goal: A public Builds witness makes the configured build return some program.
nodes.approach: Compose loader, direct public elaborator and platform-check completeness; no intermediate internal-language completeness or model back-translation.

nodes.title: build_sound
nodes.goal: Implement the exact build_sound field of Audit.Public.CORRECT.
nodes.approach: Bind the assembled proof without changing its public statement.

nodes.title: build_complete
nodes.goal: Implement the exact build_complete field of Audit.Public.CORRECT.
nodes.approach: Bind the assembled proof; only existential output, not equality with an arbitrary witness, is promised.

nodes.title: run_sound
nodes.goal: Implement the exact run_sound field for admissible programs and compatible interfaces.
nodes.approach: Connect the wrapper to forward execution adequacy.

nodes.title: run_complete
nodes.goal: Implement the exact run_complete field with existential observation budget.
nodes.approach: Connect the wrapper to reverse execution adequacy.

nodes.title: safety
nodes.goal: Implement semantic safety: Admissible and Compatible imply no Runs result is Wrong.
nodes.approach: Unfold Runs and observe, then contradict reference entry signal safety. This has no executable build/run prerequisite. Checked: safety_from_entry derives the CORRECT.safety statement from entry_never_stuck (T20's statement; run_main never returns Breaking), and stuck_entry_is_wrong shows the reduction is exact. G05 closes when T20 is proved.

nodes.title: Specify finite-source contract
nodes.goal: Specify an explicit finite source snapshot, canonical path lookup and the intended Builds/build signatures, including how the executable receives its finite inventory.
nodes.approach: Retain the five public obligations and intended finite-filesystem meaning. Record the exact proposed type/loader changes before implementing them.

evidence.summary: Retain the five public obligations and intended finite-filesystem meaning. Record the exact proposed type/loader changes before implementing them.

nodes.title: Implement finite-source lookup
nodes.goal: Implement the selected source representation and read adapter; establish lookup, uniqueness and finite-inventory facts without silently imposing arbitrary fuel caps.
nodes.approach: Keep ordinary lexing/parsing shared. Split source constructors, path handling and loader adapter proofs after A01 fixes their statements.

nodes.title: Prototype common semantic target
nodes.goal: Produce a precise direct-Audit elaborator target and runtime-lowering boundary, with a checked representative operation and capture/output-generation/GC-cast behavior evidence.
nodes.approach: The proposal, direct type emitter and partial public closure compiler are implemented. The closed capture/output/cast fixture discharges its table premise. Full language emission, recursive tables, fast caches and production integration remain separate tasks.

nodes.title: Measure current bootstrap baseline
nodes.goal: Record source/executable hashes, elapsed time and compiler fixpoint for the current production pipeline on the local x86 VM, or a measured timeout/failure.
nodes.approach: The pinned current production pipeline passed the complete compiler fixpoint in 2287.697 seconds. The frozen oracle is byte-identical to the newly checked build; see the checkpoint record and raw benchmark outputs.

evidence.summary: The pinned current production pipeline passed the complete compiler fixpoint in 2287.697 seconds. The frozen oracle is byte-identical to the newly checked build; see the checkpoint record and raw benchmark outputs.

nodes.title: Set up engine configuration comparison
nodes.goal: Specify reproducible comparisons of the closure engine with optional fast-path/pruning passes enabled or disabled, including common inputs and expected results.
nodes.approach: Use MOSS_FASTPATH/MOSS_PRUNE controls; distinguish exact closure agreement from outer optimization exceptions. Prepare capped background runs.

evidence.summary: Use MOSS_FASTPATH/MOSS_PRUNE controls; distinguish exact closure agreement from outer optimization exceptions. Prepare capped background runs.

nodes.title: Measure candidate engine configurations
nodes.goal: Collect timed fixpoint/regression results, or explicit capped failures, for the candidate production configurations.
nodes.approach: Measured all four configurations against one frozen input/oracle: default passed in 2287.697 seconds; each reduced configuration timed out at one hour during S1 generation. Timed-out configurations are not eligible passing pipelines.

evidence.summary: Measured all four configurations against one frozen input/oracle: default passed in 2287.697 seconds; each reduced configuration timed out at one hour during S1 generation. Timed-out configurations are not eligible passing pipelines.

nodes.title: Choose measured implementation boundary
nodes.goal: Choose the common public program target, exact lowering/closure boundary and required optimization passes using prototype and performance evidence.
nodes.approach: Select direct public program emission and local closure/environment lowering. Retain lazy closures and both optional transformations for the initial port because reduced configurations missed the cap. Actual port correctness, concrete lowered invariants and integrated X14 performance remain open.

evidence.summary: Select direct public program emission and local closure/environment lowering. Retain lazy closures and both optional transformations for the initial port because reduced configurations missed the cap. Actual port correctness, concrete lowered invariants and integrated X14 performance remain open.

nodes.title: Interpret metadata in the public world
nodes.goal: Accepted executable elaboration supplies the public WorldOf reading of loaded metadata and its exact requirement lists.
nodes.approach: Transport shared syntactic requirement predicates, extract raw ReqsReading, and combine with exact declarations/scopes/exports/attached/library facts. No field numbering or whole-program refinement is required; public context/code formation remains separate.

nodes.title: Emit public programs directly
nodes.goal: Make executable elaboration emit Audit programs, expressions and unified bindings, retaining implementation metadata needed for checks.
nodes.approach: Port emission by constructor, starting with the prototype. Preserve CLI/tests while keeping the semantic target fixed.

nodes.title: Prove direct contexts/basic expressions
nodes.goal: Successful direct context/basic-expression operations implement the public elaboration rules, with explicit smaller-fuel hypotheses for recursive cases.
nodes.approach: Port reusable component lemmas; decompose by source constructor. E11 must discharge all project callbacks in the global induction.

nodes.title: Prove direct call elaboration
nodes.goal: Ordinary, method and family calls emitted by the executable satisfy the corresponding public judgments.
nodes.approach: Port call lookup, satisfaction maps and demand cases directly to Audit; keep induction hypotheses explicit.

nodes.title: Prove unified source bindings
nodes.goal: Successful ordinary/provider bindings implement the public unified binding judgments under explicit recursive hypotheses.
nodes.approach: Split value/type/method/lambda/functor cases. Capture/output cases are supplied by E06-E08.

nodes.title: Implement lexical capture/generation repair
nodes.goal: Actual public-target elaboration preserves lexical captures, fixed inputs and fresh outputs, including the known merged-input/output case.
nodes.approach: Reuse private-generation preparations and the separate result-transfer repair. Integrate only what the direct public rules require; prove concrete receipts.

nodes.title: Read public promised outputs
nodes.goal: Actual fresh-link execution supplies the public promised-result reading at the target inputs and fresh output generations.
nodes.approach: Adapt the existing output-reading lemmas directly to the selected public emission invariant.

nodes.title: Prove public output availability
nodes.goal: Every promised fresh-link key is provided at its correct post-body meaning.
nodes.approach: Port checked output-presence reasoning and discharge its concrete key-reading premises.

nodes.title: Prove public method refiling
nodes.goal: Actual method aliases/refiling match the public renamed promised output keys.
nodes.approach: Use the fixed public generation reading to prove the alias equality.

nodes.title: Prove public result header
nodes.goal: The emitted public result telescope agrees with declared outputs under the chosen fresh generations.
nodes.approach: Port allocation/index/header reasoning without adding a whole-program representation layer.

nodes.title: Assemble direct fresh-link validity
nodes.goal: Actual fresh-linked code satisfies public LinkBody, retaining only the ordinary induction/invariant premises.
nodes.approach: Assemble promised reading, availability, aliases and emitted header.

nodes.title: Prove direct cached/provider reuse
nodes.goal: Reusing cached generated bodies preserves the public link/provider judgments and their lexical generation readings.
nodes.approach: Reuse authenticated creator/final-row facts where applicable; prove semantic validity directly in the public model.

nodes.title: Prove direct main/platform emission
nodes.goal: The actual emitted main, initial semantic provisions and Bool reading meet the public elaboration relation.
nodes.approach: Adapt actual main/frame/Bool receipts to public program fields; keep executable platform checking separate.

nodes.title: Cover direct ordinary function bodies
nodes.goal: Every defined source function has a public function-elaboration receipt in the final program, under explicit global induction premises.
nodes.approach: Port completed-body coverage and final lookup transport; keep final-state obligations visible.

nodes.title: Cover direct generated provider bodies
nodes.goal: Generated lambda, wrapper, forwarder and linked bodies have final public elaboration receipts.
nodes.approach: Inventory emission forms and split their coverage proofs rather than assuming a generated-body callback.

nodes.title: Assemble direct final-state coverage
nodes.goal: One final public program/world contains all required source/generated body and initial-environment receipts.
nodes.approach: Assemble coverage and monotonic final-table facts under clearly stated smaller-fuel assumptions.

nodes.title: Close direct public elaboration soundness
nodes.goal: Every successful direct executable elaboration satisfies public ElaboratesIn with no unresolved project callbacks.
nodes.approach: Close the mutual fuel/final-state induction. Do not first complete internal elaborate_sound and then prove a second source-model refinement.

nodes.title: Direct public elaboration completeness
nodes.goal: Every public-buildable bundle is accepted by direct elaboration, with the implementation fresh names permitted by the public contract.
nodes.approach: Assemble backward rule proofs and justified resource bounds, including the direct entry environment.

nodes.title: Specify selected runtime lowering
nodes.goal: Fix the closure/lowering relation from public runtime code to the selected fast representation, including all valid-domain premises.
nodes.approach: Keep a single semantic language. Any numeric IDs/maps/caches are local implementation choices with explicit correspondence lemmas.

nodes.title: Compile public expressions/bindings
nodes.goal: Implement selected closure compilation directly from public expressions and unified bindings.
nodes.approach: Port constructors and callable tables; split nonstructural lowering operations after L01 fixes the representation.

nodes.title: Define fast environment invariant
nodes.goal: Relate fast provision/type/local environments and caches to the public environments without a whole-program model translation.
nodes.approach: Specify map lookup, deferred substitutions and captured environments separately.

nodes.title: Prove fast environment operations
nodes.goal: Selected lookup, append, instantiation and grounding operations preserve the public environment relation.
nodes.approach: Adapt existing map/deferred-substitution lemmas to the selected representation.

nodes.title: Prove callable captures/exports
nodes.goal: Compiled closures retain public lexical captures, callable input interfaces and output-generation exports.
nodes.approach: Split closure creation, call entry and result export; this proof concerns public runtime behavior, independently of executable build success.

nodes.title: Relate runtime values/cast metadata
nodes.goal: Selected value/address/cast encodings preserve public value shapes and metadata lookups, or are proved identity where representations are shared.
nodes.approach: Prove only conversions actually retained after A07; split checked-handle and record cases if necessary.

nodes.title: Prove supplied-interface adapter
nodes.goal: The engine adapter invokes the same supplied interface and preserves its values, outcomes and external state.
nodes.approach: Prove actual call correspondence for arbitrary compatible interfaces; typed signatures alone are insufficient.

nodes.title: Implement public platform checker
nodes.goal: Implement finite checks for public Linked using the same source world as direct elaboration.
nodes.approach: Keep executable checker construction separate from its soundness/completeness proofs so runtime benchmarking can start early.

nodes.title: Type semantic platform initialization
nodes.goal: Public Platform.Linked and the source context establish the typing of the semantic initial provisions and primitive families.
nodes.approach: Invert the declarative platform rules. This proof does not require an executable platform checker or the concrete default-host implementation.

nodes.title: Verify retained optional transformations
nodes.goal: The exact retained fast-path/pruning configuration preserves the observations needed by public run soundness and completeness.
nodes.approach: Omitted passes need no port. For retained passes, adapt existing proofs and discharge fuel/stuck exceptions. If no passes are needed, prove the identity configuration.

nodes.title: Validate integrated one-hour bootstrap
nodes.goal: The fully integrated selected public-target pipeline bootstraps the pinned compiler to a matching fixpoint within one hour on the local x86 VM.
nodes.approach: Record source/executable/configuration hashes and timings. This is a release/performance gate, not a premise added to the logical theorem. Run in the background and investigate a capped failure.

nodes.title: Emit public type metadata
nodes.goal: Direct type emission preserves structural field names and commutes with the existing input-bounded executable type substitution.
nodes.approach: Verified emit_type and emit_full_substitution. This does not establish context meaning, machine initialization or whole elaboration soundness.

origin.note: Retrospectively identified as part of the existing obligation; not an additional previously planned task completed.

nodes.title: Preserve closed captured meanings
nodes.goal: Public grounding of a type is unchanged by a new caller behind a complete captured type scope; captured provision lookups are unchanged.
nodes.approach: Prove substitution agreement on mentioned generations and left-prefix lookup stability directly against Audit. Completeness of the captured scope remains explicit; semantic binding validity must still establish it.

origin.note: Retrospectively identified as part of the existing obligation; not an additional previously planned task completed.

nodes.title: Integrate the direct snapshot loader

decisions: Build from an explicit finite source snapshot. Direct typed-loader soundness, acceptance completeness and exact world/elaboration witness transport are checked; CLI integration and executable elaborator correctness remain open.
Make Audit the common semantic target. Executable elaboration emits public programs directly; selected runtime lowering compiles that representation to the fast engine.

Retain lazy closures and both fast-path/pruning effects for the initial port: default passed in 38m08s and all three reduced configurations timed out at one hour. The fully integrated public-target pipeline must still pass X14.
Prove semantic safety directly against Audit. It can proceed independently of executable migration, host implementation and build/run agreement.
Defer certificate-producing elaboration and the optional staged immutable-lowering candidate. Reconsider them only if evidence favors that route.
strategy.checkpoint: This checkpoint closes direct finite-loader correctness and world/elaboration witness transport, plus the public WorldOf metadata boundary. Checked safety groundwork covers ground data/local/cast/heap facts and the user-approved generation/alias/output/capture repair. The next safety frontier is source grounding/formation (T29), small code-provenance certificates (T30), and inductive callable/environment realization (T31), feeding T02. Report evidence and remaining obstructions by each two-hour active-work checkpoint; do not silently extend it.
strategy.performance: Every local bootstrap run has a one-hour cap and runs in the background. Candidate timeouts are evidence for configuration selection; X14 must eventually pass for the fully integrated pipeline. Keep quiet full Rocq compilation around two minutes and use incremental checks during proof development.
